title: Berber Chicken and Avocado Salad
description: A flavorful and refreshing salad made with Berber-spiced chicken, crispy avocado, and mixed greens.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Berber spice blend and olive oil.
Brush the spice mixture on both sides of the chicken breasts.
Grill the chicken for 6-8 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, sliced avocado, red onion, and cherry tomatoes.
Add the sliced chicken to the bowl and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
